result.summary: Found 3 issues: the promo banner text is nearly invisible due to white-on-light low contrast, restaurant images look blurry/low-resolution, and a restaurant name is clipped mid-word.

issues.description: Promotional banner '3 free deliveries for you' and subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout' use white text on a very light mint background, making it nearly unreadable
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color on the light background or darken the banner background to meet WCAG contrast requirements

issues.description: Restaurant thumbnail images in 'Fastest near you' and 'Popular right now' sections appear blurry, pixelated and low-resolution
issues.suggestion: Replace with high-resolution assets and ensure proper image loading without excessive blur/compression

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' shows truncated name 'Trattoria Piccol' cut off mid-word without ellipsis
issues.suggestion: Add proper padding and text-overflow ellipsis so card titles truncate gracefully in the horizontal carousel
